description:
Implement the canonical relative finite-field extension abstraction designed for gf2-core, covering base-field embedding, checked membership and restriction, relative degree, relative Frobenius, field-order relationships, and reusable validation certificates.

## Background

The abstraction realizes the approved extension design. Existing pairs must be covered: GF(2) into runtime `Gf2mField`, and `ConstField` bases into the binomial towers. Validation work performed once (irreducibility, compatibility, order facts) is captured in a reusable certificate value so repeated constructions do not revalidate.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gf2-core exposes the designed extension abstraction implemented for the existing binary and tower field pairs, with embedding, membership, restriction, relative degree, relative Frobenius, and order relationships behaving per the field-law conformance style of the crate.
- [hard] REQ-02: Validation certificates are constructed once, are reusable across constructions, and invalid pairs report typed errors from the core-owned error types.
- [hard] REQ-03: The shared field axiom/conformance harness gains extension-law cases exercised for the implemented pairs.
title: Implement the relative field-extension abstraction in gf2-core
